text: The transit feature logs which station you pass using Bluetooth beacons installed nearby.

An outside analytics firm receives session logs containing your account identifier.

We upload hashed email addresses from your device contacts to identify other members.
An external hosting provider processes your account records for us.
We observe your activity across partner sites to choose personalized banners.
Search queries submitted to the service are used to train our recommendation model.
We map the shape of your palm to confirm that the same person returns.
We preserve usage records for as long as they support our internal research goals.
The station finder uses a city that you type manually and does not read device location.
We explain how contacts could be imported in a future version; this version has no import function.
Account records stay on our own systems and are never supplied to outside processors.
Sponsored listings are selected at random and never depend on a visitor profile.
Our AI model is fixed and no customer messages are used to train or improve it.
Usage records are erased ninety days after the account is closed.
